SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT md5(string_agg(g.id || ':' || g."articleId" || ':' || g.number, ',' ORDER BY g.id)) || ':' || count(*) FROM legal_graph_nodes g WHERE g.law = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية') = 'b89c81af6eb322c06eb8a6bf729839d7:96' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_nodes_fingerprint

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT md5(string_agg(o.id || ':' || o.article_id || ':' || o.article_number, ',' ORDER BY o.id)) || ':' || count(*) FROM legal_thesaurus_occurrences o WHERE o.article_id IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية')) = 'c91bf302453468b27e20d8439eb1cd23:290' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_occ_fingerprint

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles WHERE id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_no_inserts_yet

CREATE TEMP TABLE cc_plan ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT id, "articleNumber" AS cur, CASE WHEN "articleNumber" BETWEEN 19 AND 23 THEN "articleNumber" + 1 WHEN "articleNumber" BETWEEN 25 AND 92 THEN "articleNumber" + 2 ELSE "articleNumber" END AS new_number, CASE WHEN "articleNumber" IN (18, 24, 93, 94) THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS new_bis FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND "articleBis" = 0 AND "articleNumber" BETWEEN 18 AND 94

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_plan) = 77 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_plan WHERE new_bis = 100) = 4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_plan WHERE new_bis = 0 AND new_number <> cur) = 73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_plan_size

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles x JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number IN (18, 19) WHERE x."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND x."articleBis" = 0 AND x."articleNumber" = 18 AND position(translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') IN translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(x.content, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) > 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_merged_18

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles x JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number IN (25, 26) WHERE x."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND x."articleBis" = 0 AND x."articleNumber" = 24 AND position(translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') IN translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(x.content, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) > 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_merged_24

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles x JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number = 95 WHERE x."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND x."articleBis" = 0 AND x."articleNumber" = 93 AND translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(substr(btrim(x.content), length(split_part(btrim(x.content), E'\n', 1)) + 1), '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') = translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_dup_93

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles x JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number = 96 WHERE x."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND x."articleBis" = 0 AND x."articleNumber" = 94 AND translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(substr(btrim(x.content), length(split_part(btrim(x.content), E'\n', 1)) + 1), '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') = translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_dup_94

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles x JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number = 95 WHERE x."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND x."articleBis" = 0 AND x."articleNumber" = 95 AND translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(x.content, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') = translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_dup_95

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles x JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number = 96 WHERE x."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND x."articleBis" = 0 AND x."articleNumber" = 96 AND translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(x.content, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') = translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_dup_96

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cc_plan p JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = p.id WHERE p.new_bis = 0 AND p.new_number <> p.cur AND (a.title <> 'المادة ' || p.cur OR left(a.search_norm, length('نظام المحاكم التجاريه' || ' الماده ' || p.cur || ' ')) <> 'نظام المحاكم التجاريه' || ' الماده ' || p.cur || ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_norm_prefix

', nullif(t."lawName",''), nullif('المادة ' || u.article_number,''), nullif((CASE WHEN u.heading LIKE 'المادة%' THEN btrim(u.heading) ELSE 'المادة ' || btrim(u.heading) END) || E'
' || btrim(u.body),''), nullif(t.classification,''), nullif(t.chapter,'')), '[ؐ-ًؚ-ٰٟۖ-ۭـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱؤئةى', 'ااااويهي'), '[^[:alpha:][:digit:]٠-٩۰-۹[:space:]]', ' ', 'g'), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), 'rule' FROM boe.unit u CROSS JOIN legal_articles t WHERE u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number IN (18, 19, 25, 26) AND t.id = 'cmpwi8w6601hnnxffzurbs0w9'

UPDATE legal_graph_nodes g SET "articleId" = t.id FROM cc_plan p, legal_articles t WHERE g."articleId" = p.id AND g.law = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND t."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND t."articleBis" = 0 AND t."articleNumber" = g.number AND t.id <> p.id

INSERT INTO legal_text_provenance (id, entity_type, entity_id, law_name, article_number, source, source_id, source_url, text_sha, retrieved_on, action, previous_text, created_at) SELECT replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 'article', 'hkm28-cc-' || u.article_number, 'نظام المحاكم التجارية', u.article_number, 'boe', 'boe:' || b.guid || '#' || u.article_number, b.url, left(encode(sha256(convert_to(u.body, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 16), b.parsed_at::date, 'insert', NULL, now() FROM boe.unit u JOIN boe.law b ON b.id = u.law_id WHERE u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number IN (18, 19, 25, 26)

INSERT INTO legal_text_provenance (id, entity_type, entity_id, law_name, article_number, source, source_id, source_url, text_sha, retrieved_on, action, previous_text, created_at) SELECT replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 'article', p.id, 'نظام المحاكم التجارية', p.new_number, 'boe', 'boe:' || b.guid || '#' || u.article_number, b.url, left(encode(sha256(convert_to(u.body, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 16), b.parsed_at::date, 'renumber', 'المادة ' || p.cur, now() FROM cc_plan p JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number = p.new_number JOIN boe.law b ON b.id = u.law_id WHERE p.new_bis = 0 AND p.new_number <> p.cur

INSERT INTO legal_text_provenance (id, entity_type, entity_id, law_name, article_number, source, source_id, source_url, text_sha, retrieved_on, action, previous_text, created_at) SELECT replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 'article', p.id, 'نظام المحاكم التجارية', p.cur, 'boe', 'boe:' || b.guid || '#' || CASE p.cur WHEN 18 THEN '18+19' WHEN 24 THEN '25+26' WHEN 93 THEN '95' ELSE '96' END, b.url, left(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.content, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 16), b.parsed_at::date, 'non_article', NULL, now() FROM cc_plan p JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = p.id CROSS JOIN boe.law b WHERE b.id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND p.new_bis = 100
SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%' AND "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية') = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_inserted

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND "articleBis" = 0) = 96 AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT "articleNumber") FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND "articleBis" = 0 AND "articleNumber" BETWEEN 1 AND 96) = 96 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND "articleBis" = 100) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_contiguous

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles a LEFT JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = 'boe26-4c65cd79392917c9508e2ff7' AND u.article_number = a."articleNumber" WHERE a."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND a."articleBis" = 0 AND (u.article_number IS NULL OR (btrim(split_part(btrim(a.content), E'\n', 1)) <> (CASE WHEN u.heading LIKE 'المادة%' THEN btrim(u.heading) ELSE 'المادة ' || btrim(u.heading) END) AND a.title <> (CASE WHEN u.heading LIKE 'المادة%' THEN btrim(u.heading) ELSE 'المادة ' || btrim(u.heading) END)) OR position(translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(u.body, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية') IN translate(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(a.content, '[\u064B-\u0652\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), '[^\u0621-\u064A0-9\u0660-\u0669]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱىة', 'ااااية')) = 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_aligned_with_boe

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND a."articleBis" = 0 AND a.search_norm <> btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(translate(regexp_replace(concat_ws(E'\n', nullif(a."lawName",''), nullif(a.title,''), nullif(a.content,''), nullif(array_to_string(a.keywords,' '),''), nullif(a.classification,''), nullif(a.chapter,'')), '[\u0610-\u061A\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u06D6-\u06ED\u0640]', '', 'g'), 'أإآٱؤئةى', 'ااااويهي'), '[^[:alpha:][:digit:]\u0660-\u0669\u06F0-\u06F9[:space:]]', ' ', 'g'), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_search_norm

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles a JOIN cc_before b ON b.id = a.id WHERE a."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND md5(a.content) = b.mc AND a.keywords IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.keywords AND a.classification IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.classification AND a.chapter IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.chapter AND a.status = b.status AND a.norm_addressee IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.norm_addressee AND a.norm_modality IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.norm_modality AND a.norm_condition IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.norm_condition AND a.norm_effect IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.norm_effect) = 96 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_before) = 96 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_contents_unchanged

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_article_case_links k JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = k."articleId" WHERE a."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND (a."articleBis" <> 0 OR (regexp_match(translate(coalesce(k."citedText", ''), '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩', '0123456789'), '([0-9]+)'))[1]::int IS DISTINCT FROM a."articleNumber")) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_links_consistent_after

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_article_case_links k WHERE k."articleId" IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية')) = (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_links_before) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cc_links_before c LEFT JOIN legal_article_case_links k ON k.id = c.id WHERE k."articleId" IS NULL OR k."articleId" NOT IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_links_same_set

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_graph_nodes g LEFT JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = g."articleId" WHERE g.law = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND (a.id IS NULL OR a."lawName" <> 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' OR a."articleBis" <> 0 OR a."articleNumber" <> g.number)) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_graph_nodes WHERE law = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية') = 96 AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT "articleId") FROM legal_graph_nodes WHERE law = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية') = 96 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_nodes_consistent_after

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_thesaurus_occurrences o JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id = o.article_id WHERE a."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND a."articleBis" = 0 AND o.article_number IS DISTINCT FROM a."articleNumber") AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_thesaurus_occurrences WHERE article_id IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية')) = 290 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_occ_consistent_after

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source = 'boe' AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية')) = 81 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source = 'boe' AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية') AND action = 'insert') = 4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source = 'boe' AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية') AND action = 'renumber') = 73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_provenance

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT "articleCount" FROM legal_systems WHERE id = (SELECT "legalSystemId" FROM legal_articles WHERE id = 'cmpwi8w6601hnnxffzurbs0w9')) = (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND "articleBis" < 100) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_article_count
